```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Setup

### Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(bayestestR)
library(loo)
library(bayesplot)
library(here)
```

### Import saved imputed dfs and observed df

```{r import-data}
analytic_dfs <- readRDS(here("Imputed Data", "analytic_dfs.rds"))
obs_df <- readRDS(here("Clean Data", "df_c_clean.rds"))
```

### Initial checks

```{r initial-checks}
length(analytic_dfs)
sapply(analytic_dfs, nrow) |> unique()
colnames(analytic_dfs[[1]])

nrow(obs_df)
colnames(obs_df)
```

### Create folders

```{r folders}
dir.create(here("Sensitivity Models"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

### Remove unconfirmed ADHD diagnoses from imputed dfs

```{r remove-unconfirmed-adhd}
stopifnot("diagnosis_c" %in% names(analytic_dfs[[1]]))

excluded_diagnoses <- c("self_identified", "suspected", "other")

# Remove from imputed dfs
analytic_dfs_excluded <- lapply(analytic_dfs, function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(!as.character(diagnosis_c) %in% excluded_diagnoses)
})

# Number of participants being excluded
sapply(analytic_dfs, function(df) sum(as.character(df$diagnosis_c) %in% excluded_diagnoses))

# Number of rows before and after
sapply(analytic_dfs, nrow)
sapply(analytic_dfs_excluded, nrow)

# Check that no excluded diagnoses remain
sapply(analytic_dfs_excluded,
       function(df) any(as.character(df$diagnosis_c) %in% excluded_diagnoses))

stopifnot(length(unique(sapply(analytic_dfs_excluded, nrow))) == 1)
```

## 1. Fully adjusted models

### Check categorical cells

```{r check-cat-cells}
df_check <- analytic_dfs[[1]] %>%
  mutate(across(c(adhd_status, autism, bc_status, adhd_med_status),
                ~ factor(as.character(.x), levels = c("N", "Y"))))

df_check %>%
  group_by(adhd_status) %>%
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    autism_Y  = sum(autism == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    autism_N  = sum(autism == "N", na.rm = TRUE),
    autism_NA = sum(is.na(autism)),
    bc_Y      = sum(bc_status == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    bc_N      = sum(bc_status == "N", na.rm = TRUE),
    bc_NA     = sum(is.na(bc_status)),
    med_Y     = sum(adhd_med_status == "Y", na.rm = TRUE),
    med_N     = sum(adhd_med_status == "N", na.rm = TRUE),
    med_NA    = sum(is.na(adhd_med_status))
  )

# Cross-tabs
df_check %>% count(adhd_status, autism, .drop = FALSE)
df_check %>% count(adhd_status, bc_status, .drop = FALSE)
df_check %>% count(adhd_status, adhd_med_status, .drop = FALSE)
```

### Set up formulas and prior

```{r hypothesis-formulas-prior}
# Formulas
formula_h1_fully_adjusted <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pds_total_s * adhd_status 
                                + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s 
                                + bmi_s + smfq_total_s)
              

formula_h2_fully_adjusted <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s * adhd_status
                                 + sed_percentile_s
                                 + bmi_s + smfq_total_s)

# Specify priors
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")
)
```

#### Check default prior

```{r default-prior}
get_prior(
  formula = formula_h1_fully_adjusted,
  data = analytic_dfs[[1]],
  family = gaussian()
)

get_prior(
  formula = formula_h2_fully_adjusted,
  data = analytic_dfs[[1]],
  family = gaussian()
)
```

## Run models

### H1 Fully Adjusted Model

```{r H1-fully-adjusted-model}
fit_h1_fully_adjusted <- brm_multiple(
  formula = formula_h1_fully_adjusted,
  data = analytic_dfs,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors,   
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,   
  seed = 12345
)

saveRDS(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, here("Sensitivity Models", "fit_h1_fully_adjusted.rds"))
```

### H1 Fully Adjusted Model output

```{r H1-fully-adjusted-output}
bayes_R2(fit_h1_fully_adjusted)

# Compute pd and ROPE
effect_h1_fully_adjusted <- describe_posterior(
  fit_h1_fully_adjusted,
  effects = "all",
  test = c("pd", "rope"),
  rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1),
  rope_ci = 1,
  centrality = c("mean", "median"),
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "hdi"
)

# Flag meaningful effects
effect_h1_fully_adjusted <- effect_h1_fully_adjusted %>%
  mutate(meaningful = pd > 0.95 & ROPE_Percentage < 0.05)

# Results summary
effect_h1_fully_adjusted %>%
  select(Parameter, Mean, Median, CI_low, CI_high, pd, ROPE_Percentage, meaningful)
```

### H1 Fully Adjusted Model diagnostics and PP checks

```{r H1-fully-adjusted-diagnostics}
cat("=== Rhat and ESS ===\n")
cat("Rhat values close to 1 indicate convergence. ESS should ideally be > 400.\n\n")
as_draws_df(fit_h1_fully_adjusted) %>% summarise_draws(default_convergence_measures())

cat("\n=== Divergent Transitions ===\n")
cat("Ideally 0. Large numbers indicate sampler problems.\n\n")
cat("Number of divergent transitions:", 
    sum(nuts_params(fit_h1_fully_adjusted)$Parameter == "divergent__" &
          nuts_params(fit_h1_fully_adjusted)$Value == 1),
    "\n")

# Trace plots
cat("\n=== Trace Plots ===\n")
mcmc_trace(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, regex_pars = "^b_") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Prior Summary
cat("\n=== Prior Summary ===\n")
cat("Priors specified for the model.\n\n")
prior_summary(fit_h1_fully_adjusted)

# Posterior Predictive Checks
cat("\n=== Posterior Predictive Checks ===\n")
cat("Density plots for each parameter.\n\n")
plot(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, ask = FALSE)

cat("\n=== PPC: Density Overlay ===\n")
cat("y_rep lines should closely follow the observed y distribution.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, ndraws = 100)

cat("\n=== PPC: Error Histogram ===\n")
cat("Errors should be approximately normally distributed around 0.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, type = "error_hist")

cat("\n=== PPC: Mean ===\n")
cat("Observed mean (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated means.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, type = "stat", stat = "mean")

cat("\n=== PPC: Median ===\n")
cat("Observed median (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated medians.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, type = "stat", stat = "median")

cat("\n=== PPC: SD ===\n")
cat("Observed SD (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated SDs.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, type = "stat", stat = "sd")

cat("\n=== PPC: Scatter Average ===\n")
cat("Points should cluster around the diagonal. Systematic patterns indicate misfit.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h1_fully_adjusted, type = "scatter_avg")

# Pareto-k
cat("\n=== Pareto-k ===\n")
loo_h1_fully_adjusted <- loo(fit_h1_fully_adjusted)
pareto_k_table(loo_h1_fully_adjusted)
plot(loo_h1_fully_adjusted, label_points = TRUE)
```

## 3. Prior 1 preregistered

## Set up formulas and prior

```{r prior1-hypothesis-formulas-prior}
# Formulas
formula_h1_prior_1 <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pds_total_s * adhd_status 
                         + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2_prior_1 <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s * adhd_status 
                         + sed_percentile_s)

# Specify priors
priors1 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 0.75), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")
)
```

```{r prior1-default-prior}
  family = gaussian()
)
```

```{r H2-prior1-diagnostics}
cat("=== Rhat and ESS ===\n")

cat("\n=== PPC: Mean ===\n")

pp_check(fit_h2_prior_1, type = "stat", stat = "mean")

cat("\n=== PPC: Median ===\n")
```

```{r H2-prior4-output}
bayes_R2(fit_h2_prior_4)

# Compute pd and ROPE
effect_h2_prior_4 <- describe_posterior(
  fit_h2_prior_4,
  effects = "all",
  test = c("pd", "rope"),
  rope_range = c(-0.1, 0.1),
  rope_ci = 1,
  centrality = c("mean", "median"),
  ci = 0.95,
  ci_method = "hdi"
)

# Flag meaningful effects
effect_h2_prior_4 <- effect_h2_prior_4 %>%
  mutate(meaningful = pd > 0.95 & ROPE_Percentage < 0.05)

# Results summary
effect_h2_prior_4 %>%
  select(Parameter, Mean, Median, CI_low, CI_high, pd, ROPE_Percentage, meaningful)
```

### H2 Prior 4 Model diagnostics and PP checks

```{r H2-prior4-diagnostics}
cat("=== Rhat and ESS ===\n")
cat("Rhat values close to 1 indicate convergence. ESS should ideally be > 400.\n\n")
as_draws_df(fit_h2_prior_4) %>% summarise_draws(default_convergence_measures())

cat("\n=== Divergent Transitions ===\n")
cat("Ideally 0. Large numbers indicate sampler problems.\n\n")
cat("Number of divergent transitions:", 
    sum(nuts_params(fit_h2_prior_4)$Parameter == "divergent__" &
          nuts_params(fit_h2_prior_4)$Value == 1),
    "\n")

# Trace plots
cat("\n=== Trace Plots ===\n")
mcmc_trace(fit_h2_prior_4, regex_pars = "^b_") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Prior Summary
cat("\n=== Prior Summary ===\n")
cat("Priors specified for the model.\n\n")
prior_summary(fit_h2_prior_4)

# Posterior Predictive Checks
cat("\n=== Posterior Predictive Checks ===\n")
cat("Density plots for each parameter.\n\n")
plot(fit_h2_prior_4, ask = FALSE)

cat("\n=== PPC: Density Overlay ===\n")
cat("y_rep lines should closely follow the observed y distribution.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_prior_4, ndraws = 100)

cat("\n=== PPC: Error Histogram ===\n")
cat("Errors should be approximately normally distributed around 0.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_prior_4, type = "error_hist")

cat("\n=== PPC: Mean ===\n")
cat("Observed mean (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated means.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_prior_4, type = "stat", stat = "mean")

cat("\n=== PPC: Median ===\n")
cat("Observed median (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated medians.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_prior_4, type = "stat", stat = "median")

cat("\n=== PPC: SD ===\n")
cat("Observed SD (dark line) should fall within the distribution of replicated SDs.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_prior_4, type = "stat", stat = "sd")

cat("\n=== PPC: Scatter Average ===\n")
cat("Points should cluster around the diagonal. Systematic patterns indicate misfit.\n\n")
pp_check(fit_h2_prior_4, type = "scatter_avg")

# Pareto-k
cat("\n=== Pareto-k ===\n")
loo_h2_prior_4 <- loo(fit_h2_prior_4)
pareto_k_table(loo_h2_prior_4)
plot(loo_h2_prior_4, label_points = TRUE)
```

## 7. H2 Model excluding participants without a confirmed ADHD diagnosis

## Set up formula

```{r H2-exclude-unconfirmed-prior}
# Formulas
formula_h2_excluded <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s * adhd_status 
                         + sed_percentile_s)
```

### H2 Model excluding unconfirmed ADHD

```{r H2-exclude-unconfirmed}
fit_h2_excluded <- brm_multiple(
  formula = formula_h2_excluded,
  data = analytic_dfs_excluded,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = priors,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  seed = 12345
)

saveRDS(fit_h2_excluded, here("Sensitivity Models", "fit_h2_excluded.rds"))
```
